summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FASE G-0 Configuration Center (Pusat Pengaturan). All backend APIs working correctly with proper permission model. Frontend successfully implements redirect cards, deep-linking, and role-based access control. Manager can edit exactly 31 settings (HR & lot/makloon), admin can edit 96 settings, sales/warehouse have 0 editable settings.
passed_tests: BACKEND-1: Registry caps correct for all roles (admin=96 editable, manager=31 editable, sales=0, warehouse=0)
BACKEND-2: tax.pph_items has row_shape='list' with 5 columns for structured table editor
BACKEND-3: Manager can successfully edit hr.overtime.multiplier (has hr.manage_payroll permission)
BACKEND-4: Manager correctly forbidden from editing tax.ppn_rate (403 with clear permission message)
BACKEND-5: Admin correctly blocked from editing hr.ptkp_table with explanation about TER method
BACKEND-6: Warehouse correctly forbidden from editing any config (403)
US-G0-1: Admin can access Pusat Pengaturan, navigate to Pajak group, and modify tax.ppn_rate (value persisted after refresh)
US-G0-2a: Tax config redirect card present in Finance > Pajak > PPh & Rekap > Konfigurasi tab, old form deleted, redirect button works and focuses tax.ppn_rate card with data-focused='1'
US-G0-5: Manager can see Pusat Pengaturan, limited rights banner displayed, can edit HR settings (input enabled), cannot edit tax settings, 'Koreksi Harga & Daftar Dampak' tab correctly hidden
US-G0-6: Sales role cannot see Pusat Pengaturan in sidebar, sales menus work correctly
US-G0-6: Warehouse role cannot see Pusat Pengaturan in sidebar, warehouse menus (GUDANG > Operasi WMS) work correctly

US-G0-2e: Incentive config redirect in CRM (not tested)

observations: Login system uses role selector buttons that auto-login with pre-filled credentials
Deep-link system works correctly - clicking redirect button navigates to Pusat Pengaturan and focuses the correct card with data-focused='1' attribute
Limited rights banner displays for manager with correct messaging about editable settings
Permission model correctly enforced at both backend (API) and frontend (UI) levels
High-risk settings (like tax.ppn_rate) require reason field to be filled before saving
All 4 tabs visible in Pusat Pengaturan for admin: Pengaturan, Kesehatan Konfigurasi, Riwayat Perubahan, Koreksi Harga & Daftar Dampak
Manager sees only 3 tabs (Koreksi Harga & Daftar Dampak hidden as expected)
Sales and warehouse roles correctly do not see Pusat Pengaturan in sidebar
ConfigRedirectCard successfully replaces old tax config form in Finance > Pajak section
